termux-row-action-fixes.title: Settings row action fixes: TERMUX_NOT_RUNNING launches Termux, NotInstalled goes straight to F-Droid
termux-row-action-fixes.description:
Two related Settings-row tweaks in app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/settings/AgentBehaviorSettingsPage.kt (combined into one task because both touch the same row-action branch and conflict if parallelized).

1) TERMUX_NOT_RUNNING (mapped at TermuxBridgeManager.kt:322, declared at TermuxBridgeStatus.kt:23): copy at AgentBehaviorSettingsPage.kt:219 says "open Termux once" but the row tap at :118 still calls manager.setup(). Replace with a launchTermux() Intent (Termux MainActivity), then re-probe on resume so the user does not have to hunt for the app.

2) NotInstalled row at :107 still calls manager.setup() before falling back to F-Droid even though the install probe (TermuxBridgeDependencies.kt:60, manager line 258, commit 6f06c64c) already proved Termux is absent. Tap should open F-Droid (or Play-Store fallback) directly.
acceptCriteria: TERMUX_NOT_RUNNING row tap launches Termux MainActivity via Intent
After launching Termux, returning to Settings re-probes status
NotInstalled row tap opens F-Droid Termux page directly (no intermediate setup() call)
Existing setup() retry path preserved for other NeedsSetupReason values
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lint passes
termux-row-action-fixes.note: codex flagged MEDIUM about openTermuxInstallPage Play-Store fallback — out of scope (pre-existing helper from 6f06c64c, Play-Store Termux is actively broken so fallback would be user-hostile)

termux-runtime-permission-grant.title: Termux row: request RUN_COMMAND permission inline (runtime dangerous permission)
termux-runtime-permission-grant.description: Investigation w-investigate-termux-permission found Termux declares RUN_COMMAND as prot=dangerous; ClosePaw declares it in manifest but never calls requestPermissions() at runtime, so on first launch (and any reinstall after a grant decision is wiped) the row shows PERMISSION_MISSING and tap just loops SecurityException. Fix mirrors the Shizuku permission flow (commit 6efd47ea): when reason is PERMISSION_MISSING, tap should call ActivityCompat.requestPermissions and proceed on grant; toggle ON should proactively request; permanent-denial fallback opens App Details Settings.
acceptCriteria: Tapping the Termux Shell row when reason is PERMISSION_MISSING triggers the system permission dialog (not just retry setup)
On grant: row auto-retries setup() and persists to Ready
On deny: row stays Needs Setup with clear copy
On permanent denial (Don't ask again): tap opens ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS for ClosePaw
Proactively requests on toggle ON to avoid the first-launch broken-look
Already-granted path: no spurious dialog
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lint passes
Manual verify on nubia after pm revoke + reinstall: tap toggle ON → system dialog appears → grant → row goes Ready
termux-runtime-permission-grant.note: Commit 47fa647c. Used rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()) — modern Compose path, no suspend bridge needed. Pure classifyRunCommandPermission(isGranted, hasAttempted, shouldShowRationale) matrix → Granted | Request | OpenAppSettings. hasAttempted process-scoped to disambiguate shouldShowRationale=false (returned both before first ask AND after Don't ask again). 6/6 unit tests pass. Verified live on nubia: pm revoke + toggle ON → system dialog → grant → Ready; toggle OFF/ON already-granted → no spurious dialog; row tap from PERMISSION_MISSING state → dialog → grant → Ready.
